reply.text: I can't give you an amount for pre-workout, scoops or otherwise. The right number depends on the product, how much caffeine is in it, and how you handle stimulants, and that's a call for a doctor or dietitian. What I can say is that pre-workouts are mostly caffeine plus other stimulants, so the label and your own tolerance matter more than any rule of thumb from me. Sleep, food and a solid warm-up do more for a session than most scoops will. If you want, I can look at how your training has been feeling lately and work out where the energy dips.
